items.t: RTX (RTX) Lands Next Generation Nuclear Cruise Missile Work For The Navy
items.sum: RTX (NYSE:RTX) unit Raytheon won a U.S. Navy contract to progress a next generation, submarine launched nuclear cruise missile program. The award advances early development work on the missile system, aimed at launch from U.S. Navy attack submarines.
